A '''toxin detector''' was a small handheld device that could scan [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and drink to determine if it was spoiled or [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]]. It could provide a visual indication via a blinking green light if the item scanned was safe for consumption. It could also be set to vibrate when a poison was detected. A more expensive model was concealed in a bracelet or other piece of jewelry for maximum concealability.
